landing.hero.title:
One platform for your
whole church family
landing.hero.subtitle: Manage members, track attendance across multiple services, record tithes & offerings, send SMS updates, and follow up with your flock all in one simple, mobile-friendly system.
landing.problems.label: The Challenge
landing.problems.title: Sound familiar?
landing.problems.subtitle: Many churches struggle with disconnected processes that make it hard to truly know and serve their congregation.
landing.problems.scattered_text: Notebooks, spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups — member information is everywhere except where you need it.
landing.problems.attendance_text: Multiple services, mid-week fellowships, and special events — but no clear picture of who's showing up.
landing.problems.giving_text: Tithes and offerings collected manually with limited transparency, making accountability difficult.
landing.problems.followup_text: New members, absentees, and those in need slip through the cracks without a system to flag and track pastoral care.
landing.features.label: Core Modules
landing.features.title: Everything your church needs
landing.features.subtitle: Six powerful modules working together to help your church run smoothly and care for every member.
landing.features.members_text: Complete member profiles with family links, contact info, ministry involvement, and a self-service profile completion flow for new members.
landing.features.attendance_text: Record attendance for Sunday services (1st, 2nd, 3rd), mid-week meetings, and special events. View trends per service and per member.
landing.features.giving_text: Log every contribution by category — tithes, offerings, pledges, special seeds. Members can view their own giving history.
landing.features.comms_text: Bulk SMS, targeted messages by group or department, birthday greetings, and push notifications — reach your congregation wherever they are.
landing.features.pastoral_text: Flag members for follow-up, track visitations, log counselling notes, and ensure no one falls through the cracks.
landing.features.reporting_text: Generate attendance, financial, and growth reports. Audit trails keep everything transparent and trustworthy.
landing.roles.label: Built for Everyone
landing.roles.title: Who is ChurchOS for?
landing.roles.subtitle: Five distinct roles, each with their own tailored dashboard and access level.
landing.roles.admin_desc: Full system control — manage users, configure settings, and oversee all church operations.
landing.roles.pastor_desc: Bird's-eye view of church health — attendance trends, giving patterns, and flagged members.
landing.roles.leader_desc: Manage your department's roster, record attendance, and track follow-ups for your group.
landing.roles.finance_desc: Record and categorise giving, generate financial reports, and maintain accountability.
landing.roles.member_desc: View your own profile, track attendance, see giving history, and stay updated with announcements.
landing.cta.title: Ready to bring your church together?
landing.cta.subtitle: Join hundreds of Ghanaian churches already using ChurchOS to manage their congregation with clarity and care.
